label: Horror
context_hint: Unsettling, dread-soaked atmosphere — decayed or wrong-feeling environments, oppressive darkness broken by weak, flickering, or sourceless light. Compositions distort normal perspective slightly (too-empty rooms, too-long hallways, something just out of frame). Figures may be partially obscured or subtly inhuman. Avoid overt gore in favor of psychological unease — the wrongness should be felt more than seen.
